Name: Sub on Demand - Year-Round Submarine
Author: DarkRobon
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Sub on Demand[/b][/size]
[size=3]The captain is keeping regular hours. Yours.[/size][/center]

Fancy a Blobfish in spring? A Midnight Squid before lunch? Sub on Demand keeps the Night Market submarine at the beach throughout the year, ready for a deep-sea fishing trip whenever you can reach the dock.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Adds the submarine and a short connecting pier to the ordinary beach.[/*]
[*]Allows boarding throughout the day in every season, including outside the Night Market's usual boarding hours.[/*]
[*]Keeps the captain's normal [b]1,000g dive fee[/b], descent, ascent, and underwater atmosphere.[/*]
[*]Uses the game's existing submarine fishing pool, including [b]Blobfish, Spook Fish, and Midnight Squid[/b].[/*]
[*]Returns you to the beach outside the Night Market and the festival beach during the Night Market.[/*]
[*]Releases an abandoned submarine trip once everyone has left, so a warp-out doesn't leave the boat permanently occupied for the day.[/*]
[/list]
The rest of the Night Market still follows its normal schedule.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/b], with a SMAPI version compatible with your game.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.3.2 or later[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download the main Sub on Demand file.[/*]
[*]Extract the ZIP into your game's [b]Mods[/b] folder. The finished paths should be [b]Mods/SubOnDemand/manifest.json[/b] and [b]Mods/SubOnDemand/SubOnDemand.dll[/b].[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Taking a trip[/b][/size][/color]
Head to the beach and follow the western pier south. Take the short pier to the submarine on its left, interact with the door, and talk to the captain inside. Pay 1,000g, enjoy the dive, and fish once the hatch opens. Talk to the captain again when you are ready to surface, then leave through the exit.

The fishing rules, catch chances, and trip charge come from the game's submarine. You still need a fishing rod, enough money for the dive, and enough time to get home.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Compatibility and multiplayer[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Existing saves:[/b] Intended to work with existing saves; a new farm is not required.[/*]
[*][b]Beach overhauls:[/b] Mods that move the western pier, replace the beach or Night Market maps, or change the submarine entrance or exit may need a compatibility patch.[/*]
[*][b]Co-op:[/b] Install the same version on the host and every farmhand. The submarine remains unavailable for boarding while a trip is underway.[/*]
[/list][color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Updating and uninstalling[/b][/size][/color]
[b]Update:[/b] Close the game, remove the old Mods/SubOnDemand folder, and extract the new version into Mods.

[b]Uninstall:[/b] Return to your farm, save, and close the game. Remove Mods/SubOnDemand. Move any objects placed on the added pier back onto ordinary land before uninstalling.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Questions[/b][/size][/color]

[b]Can I fish all night?[/b]
Boarding hours are removed, but time still passes normally and the usual 2am collapse still applies.

[b]Does this make the whole Night Market permanent?[/b]
Only the submarine and its connecting pier are available year-round. Shops and the Mermaid Show keep their normal festival schedule.

[b]Does it add new fish or make fishing easier?[/b]
It gives you more opportunities to visit the existing submarine. It adds no fish and changes no fishing difficulty or catch probabilities.

[b]Why does the boat say it is in use?[/b]
An active dive blocks new passengers. Wait for it to return. If everyone leaves using warp items or disconnects, the host releases the empty boat on the next one-second update.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Reporting a problem[/b][/size][/color]
Use this page's Bugs tab and include your game version, SMAPI version, mod version, season/day/time, what happened, and what you expected. For co-op issues, say whether you were the host or a farmhand. Include any beach or submarine mods you use and a link to your [url=https://smapi.io/log]parsed SMAPI log[/url].


[size=4][b][color=#ff7700]Credits[/color][/b][/size]
[list]

[*][b]Pathoschild and the SMAPI contributors[/b] - SMAPI and the mod build tools.[/*]
[*][b]The Stardew Valley modding community[/b] - modding documentation and shared knowledge.[/*]
[/list]
